headline: Code is read
body: Every function I write, I ask: will the next engineer hate me for this? Clean naming, logical structure, no clever hacks that turn into tomorrow's bugs.
bodyEmphasis: will the next engineer hate me for this?

headline: Ship fast.
body: Speed and quality aren't opposites. With the right architecture upfront, you move faster in month 6 than month 1. That's the difference between a codebase and a liability.
bodyEmphasis: you move faster in month 6 than month 1.

headline: Full stack means
body: I don't throw code over the fence. From DB schema to deployment pipeline, I own the outcome — not just my slice of the ticket.

headline: Right tool.
body: Not everything needs microservices. Not everything needs a monolith. Experience teaches you when to reach for what — and when to keep it simple.
bodyEmphasis: Experience teaches you when to reach for what
